engine.notes: Coalition is the long-form center, CSz the short-form one. HATTheatre's adult class says in its own words that it is not an improv class; the Funny Bone and Sandman are stand-up rooms.

entries.name: Coalition Theater
entries.summary: Richmond's long-form improv home, founded as the Richmond Comedy Coalition in 2009 and in its own Broad Street theater since 2013, with shows Thursday to Saturday, a community jam night and improv, sketch and stand-up classes.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu-Sat, 7:30 and 9 pm, free to $20; Improv 101 six weeks $190, holiday session starts late Oct 2026
signals: Own theater at 8 W Broad St since 2013
entries.reasons: Seventeen years, a permanent downtown theater, three show nights, an open community night, scholarships and a dated class session make it the complete package; the ladder above 102 is thinner than the big-city schools.

entries.name: CSz Richmond Theater
entries.summary: Home of ComedySportz in Richmond since 1996: a West Broad Street theater run by the nonprofit Yes Balloon, with short-form matches, Bardalicious Shakespeare improv, leagues and year-round classes for all ages.
entries.schedule: ComedySportz matches and Improv Arena shows; classes year-round, 2026 summer camps
signals: Own theater at 8906 W Broad St, Ste H
Classes for all ages, all year
entries.reasons: Thirty years and a theater of its own in a national format, but match nights and class levels are not readable on the site, so the show and class points rest on its own general claims.

entries.name: Bridge 9 Theater
entries.summary: A 501(c)(3) improv company with no stage of its own that plays Crescent Collective and the Firehouse and runs a community jam, a six-week Intro to Improv, pay-what-you-will drop-ins and an Autism Improv Team.
entries.schedule: Intro to Improv Sundays 6-7:30 pm from Sept 27; Closing Night Oct 7, 2026 at the Firehouse
signals: Community improv jam in Church Hill
entries.reasons: An inclusive program with a jam, a beginner class and dated 2026 shows, scored low for having no venue of its own, a footer still marked 2024 and no levels beyond intro.
